text: Matthew's recovery averaged 74 % over the last 21 days and hit 99 % on the night of Thursday, September 24, with a food log for every one of the 20 days behind it — so protein and recovery can now be read side by side. I've asked him to keep logging every meal through Friday, October 2. If blood-sugar advice trims carbs and his recovery holds, carbs mattered; if it drops, protein did. Twenty-one days is enough to watch, not to conclude.
